correctness.rationale: For odd p<q the source squarefree Φ formula gives Φ(pq)=(p−β(p))(q−β(q)). Neither p nor q divides its own factor, and q>p+1≥p−β(p) excludes cross-divisibility from q to the p-factor, so failure occurs iff p|(q−β(q)). CRT yields two distinct reduced classes modulo 4p, each fixed-p progression contributes Li(X/p)/(2(p−1)). For p up to fixed P, PNT-AP gives truncated main constant; for P<p≤X^(1/3), Brun–Titchmarsh gives ≤8X/[p(p−1)logX]; for X^(1/3)<p<√X, integer counts give O(X^(2/3)); convergent prime tail then gives E(X)~C X/logX and Landau gives density one within odd squarefree semiprimes. Independent exhaustive local check 328564 pairs pq≤2e6 found 45757 non-G-cyclic and no mismatches. Independently summing primes p≤1e7 gives C lower 0.27315666318973836 and rigorous integer telescoping tail <1e−7, so six decimals 0.273157; finite checks corroborate only, analytic argument proves asymptotic.
residual_risks: Only odd squarefree pq, p<q, not prime squares, even semiprimes or the full integer population.
PNT in AP, Brun–Titchmarsh and Landau theorem are cited published analytic inputs.
